title: StoryBiblePanel + knowledge tab spacing normalization
description: Apply standardized spacing pass to StoryBiblePanel.tsx and all knowledge tab components (CharacterTab, LocationTab, PlotTab, SkillTab). Normalize section headers to 'text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500', card padding to 'p-4', form field gaps to 'gap-3', and list item padding to 'py-2 px-3'.
action: In StoryBiblePanel.tsx and src/components/knowledge/*.tsx: replace inconsistent section headers with 'text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500 dark:text-dark-text-muted', normalize card/section wrapper padding to 'p-4', form field vertical gap to 'gap-3 flex flex-col', list item interactive rows to 'py-2 px-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-dark-surface'.

convergence.definition_of_done: All knowledge panel section headers use the standardized label style. Card padding and form gaps are consistent across all 5 files.

files.change: Normalize section headers to text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider; card wrappers to p-4

files.target: section headers, list items, form gaps
section headers, list items, form gaps
section headers, list items, form gaps
section headers, list items, form gaps

implementation: Step 1 — Read each file and identify ALL section label elements (e.g., <span>, <h3>, <div> acting as labels). Replace their className with 'text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500 dark:text-dark-text-muted'.
Step 2 — Find card/section wrapper divs with inconsistent padding (e.g., p-3, p-2, p-5). Normalize to 'p-4' for main content cards, 'p-3' for compact list items.
Step 3 — Find form field containers (stacked label+input pairs). Ensure each uses 'flex flex-col gap-3' for consistent vertical rhythm.
Step 4 — Find list item rows that have hover states. Normalize to 'flex items-center gap-2 py-2 px-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-dark-surface/50 transition-colors'.
Step 5 — Run pnpm test -- --run to confirm no regressions.

reference.pattern: AppHeader.tsx or ChatSidebar.tsx section labels as reference for the uppercase tracking-wider pattern

rationale.chosen_approach: Direct Tailwind class normalization — no new abstractions. Match existing panel patterns.
decision_factors: REQ-B requires consistent spacing across panels
rationale.tradeoffs: Manual class-by-class audit required per file.
